about_the_game:
Desktop Companion is a customizable desktop assistant that lets you bring life to your screen. Import your own 2D or 3D models and turn them into interactive companions that live right on your desktop — always within reach, always by your side.

✨ Core Features:

  • 🧍 Custom Models – Add your own 2D gifs or full 3D characters. Whether it's a mascot, a creature, or even yourself – if you can imagine it, you can load it.

  • 🖱️ Mouse Interactions – Drag, throw, and play with your companion directly on your screen. They're fully draggable and responsive to your cursor.

  • 📏 Resizing – Scale your companion up or down with ease. Want a tiny helper or a full-screen presence? It's your choice.

  • 🎞️ Animations – Add life with custom animations. Animate idle states, movements, or reactions — your companion becomes more expressive.

  • 🌍 Gravity & Physics – Enable gravity for fun and realistic motion. Let your model bounce around or fall naturally based on your desktop layout.

💛 Always There for You

Sometimes, it’s just nice to have something on your screen — something that reacts, moves, and reminds you that you’re not alone. Whether you're working, studying, or just relaxing, Desktop Companion gives you a little presence on your desktop — a quiet friend who’s always around.

Note: The 2D and 3D models shown in the screenshots and trailer are for demonstration purposes only. They are not included in the application and serve only to showcase functionality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (DirectX 10 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU for best 3D performance
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Desktop Companion lets you add interactive 2D and 3D characters to your screen. Drag them around, resize them, animate them, and even apply gravity. It's a fun, customizable way to make your desktop feel alive — and a little less lonely.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese
